name: סֶלַע
summary: Sela is the Edomite stronghold that Amaziah captured after his victory in the Valley of Salt and renamed Joktheel. The name is the noun סֶלַע “crag, cliff”.

evidence.note: Amaziah takes Sela in battle and calls it Joktheel.
The Amorite border ran “from the ascent of Akrabbim, from Sela and upward”.

note: Moved from the name word of the former one-word entry for סֶלַע; the common noun “crag, cliff, rocky refuge” is in the root entry סלע, which this name links to. TIPNR keys the place Sela@Jdg.1.36 and counts Joktheel as its other name.
